errors.text_span: Eine weitere farbige Linie stellt die Jahre 2020, 2021, 2022 und 2023 dar.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that a single colored line represents four distinct years (2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023). The chart legend clearly shows four separate, individually colored lines for these years (pink for 2020, purple for 2021, green for 2022, and light blue for 2023).

errors.text_span: Der Startpunkt der Linie für 2024 liegt bei etwa 30 Prozent im Januar
errors.evidence: The dark blue line for 2024 clearly starts at approximately 90% in January, not 30%.

errors.text_span: und steigt kontinuierlich auf etwa 95 Prozent im August, um dann auf etwa 90 Prozent im Dezember zu fallen.
errors.evidence: The description of the trend for the 2024 line is incorrect. The line does not rise continuously from the start; it first falls from January (approx. 90%) to a low in April (approx. 63%) and then rises for the rest of the year, peaking around November.

errors.text_span: Der Startpunkt der Linie für 2025 liegt bei etwa 35 Prozent im Januar
errors.evidence: The line for 2025 starts at approximately 60% in January, not 35%.

errors.text_span: und steigt kontinuierlich auf etwa 95 Prozent im Juli, um dann auf etwa 90 Prozent im Dezember zu fallen.
errors.evidence: The chart only shows data for the 2025 line from January to mid-March, during which it is decreasing. The description fabricates a trend for the rest of the year, including an increase to 95% in July, which is not present in the figure.
The description mentions two of the blue squares representing the 'Speicherverpflichtung' (storage obligation) but omits the third one, which is located in November at approximately 90%.
